summary:
Implementation plan for FocusPilot Agent Overhaul:
1. Distinct 7-day Monday-Sunday weekly timetable schema and batch sync (sync_weekly_timetable) to fix single-day overwriting.
2. Active distraction friction with full-screen focus overlay during deep work blocks.
3. Enhanced device telemetry and agent control: top app packages breakdown, STREAM_ALARM ringtone bypassing DND/silent mode, Karunya campus geofence/Wi-Fi context detection, silent camera snap and audio recording.
4. Settings cleanup and reliable start/stop bridge execution with auto-updating screen time telemetry.
